name: Global Capital Markets Limited
about: Global Capital Markets Limited, a non-banking finance company, engages in finance and investment activities primarily in India. The company engages in the provision of finance to corporate houses and HNIs on a short-term and long-term basis; investment and trading in shares and securities, including equity and FNO; trading in commodities market; and other capital market related activities. It is also involved in the real estate and software related activities. The company was formerly known as Global Capital Market & Infrastructures Limited. Global Capital Markets Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Mumbai, India.
